subject: Matematik

sources.activity_book: References printed in textbook; independent copy not yet audited

audit_notes: SK 2.2 in the available DSKP transcription repeats the 2.1.x numbering; textbook pages 10–12 use 2.2.1–2.2.3. Keep draft textbook numbering until visual audit.
Operations under SP 3.3.1 and 4.3.1 are explicitly restricted to no regrouping. Other concrete fact-building activities stay within 20.
All lesson numbers and time allocations are proposed; full SK/SP wording, workbook verification, annual pacing and rendering pending.
